{{Quote|Sergeant Wenna'lah! Target damage assessment!|Jarrow Rusher|<ref name="Knight Errant (novel)">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>}}
'''Wenna'lah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] within the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] force [[Rusher's Brigade]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Wenna'lah and Rusher's Brigade [[Battle of Gazzari|fought]] for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], against the [[Odionate|forces]] of Daiman's brother [[Odion]]. During the battle, Wenna'lah acted as an [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] spotter and after Odion deployed a [[Death Spiral]] attack vehicle, [[Jarrow Rusher]], the leader of Rusher's [[Brigade/Legends|Brigade]], ordered Wenna'lah to assess the damage that the brigade's artillery had inflicted on the Spiral. Wenna'ah reported that the strike had caused zero damage, because the Death Spiral had raised its [[Deflector shield/Legends|energy shields]].
